description: This file defines a React component named `ActivityLogContactNoteCreated` that renders a log entry when a contact note is created in an activity log. It includes UI elements such as avatars, reference fields to contacts, sales, and companies, and date formatting, utilizing Material UI components and react-admin references.

methods.name: ActivityLogContactNoteCreated
methods.description: React functional component that displays a created contact note in the activity log, including avatar, sale information, contact details, and relative date.
